nodes.title: Personalised Dachshund 1 Word Art Poster Print
nodes.descriptionHtml:
If they talk about their dachshund more than anything else, this personalised dachshund word art print is the gift for them: a sausage dog portrait in soft greys, filled with the words that sum their dog up. It's a lovely gift for a new puppy, a dog's birthday or a dog-mad friend.

Your personalised dachshund word art print, made with your words

Type the dog's name in the first box; it appears once, in pride of place. In the second box, type 20 to 30 words separated by commas: nicknames, favourite walks, toys, treats and the people they love. We repeat them in different sizes, fonts and shades to fill the design. Tips: use single words or phrases of no more than three words, put commas between them and check your spelling. No icons, emoji or accented letters, please. We print exactly what you type.
